title: Google Calendar
summary: Ava reads your calendar to answer what's on, when you're free and who you're meeting. Optionally, she can also add, move and decline events for you.

tools.name: calendar_events
tools.description: List the owner's Google Calendar events for a day or range. Returns events you can cite.

days.description: How many days to cover (1 to 14)

query.description: Optional keyword: a person, meeting name or place

tools.name: calendar_free_busy
tools.description: When the owner is busy and free on a day or range (working hours 08:00 to 20:00 in their time zone). Use it to suggest or check a time before proposing one.

days.description: How many days to cover (1 to 14)

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Add an event to the owner's calendar. With no attendees it is added at once; with attendees, Google would email them an invitation, so it waits for the owner's approval first.

title.description: The event's title, e.g. 'Lunch with Priya'

when.description: When it starts, in words: 'tomorrow at 3pm', 'Friday 10:30'

attendees.description: Email addresses to invite. Leave out for a private event.

tools.name: move_event
tools.description: Move one of the owner's events to a new time. If other people are invited, Google would email them the change, so it waits for the owner's approval first.

id.description: The event's id: the part after ava://cal/ in a calendar_events source. Never guess it.

when.description: The new start, in words: 'tomorrow at 4pm'

minutes.description: New length in minutes (default: keep the length)

tools.name: decline_event
tools.description: Decline an invitation on the owner's behalf. Google tells the organiser, so it always waits for the owner's approval.

id.description: The event's id: the part after ava://cal/ in a calendar_events source. Never guess it.

note.description: Optional short note for the organiser

actions.title: Let Ava add, move and decline events
actions.description: Asks Google for permission to change your calendar (calendar.events). Anything that would email other people waits for your approval.
